title: Temporal field authority and transport-neutral resolution
summary: DATE and DATETIME fields use Single Time Service for temporal meaning, ConnectSelector for invocation routing, and NotNotes for authoritative field/evidence persistence.
invariants: NotNotes must not infer timezone or instant meaning from a displayed date/time string.
DATE is a civil date; a floating DATETIME remains floating unless a timezone policy is declared.
Zoned DATETIME resolution belongs to Single Time Service and must fail closed on gaps or unresolved folds.
ConnectSelector owns provider/transport selection; NotNotes does not hard-code DIRECT, RPC or Queue Fabric.
Accepted zoned temporal meaning retains zone, instant, tzdb edition and resolution provenance separately from the human field value.
Previously accepted evidence may be read after restart without calling Time Service; a new temporal mutation still requires the service boundary.
procedure: Resolve or validate DATE/DATETIME through the injected MiniNotesTimeGateway.
For zoned DATETIME, issue the Time Service request through ConnectSelector destination TIME.
Persist the canonical human value on the document and temporal authority facts in the temporal_evidence application table.
Expose temporal policy and accepted evidence through semantic document projection.
Reject a new temporal mutation when the Time Service boundary is unavailable.

provenance.claim: Published gateway routes zoned local resolution through ConnectSelector and returns temporal authority facts.
Dev17 retains accepted temporal evidence separately from the field value.
Dev17 persists temporal evidence keyed by document and field.
Single Time Service sphere owns temporal semantics and authority.
